sql_templates.description: Fetch sectors improving in stage and breadth.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT sd.sector, sd.breadth_signal, sd.change_5d, ma.stage2_pct
FROM breadth.sector_daily sd
JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above ma ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date
WHERE sd.snapshot_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days')
ORDER BY ma.stage2_pct DESC, sd.change_5d DESC
LIMIT 10;

sql_templates.description: Select candidate stocks from improving sectors.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT ss.symbol, ss.company_name, ss.stage, ss.trading_signal
FROM scores.stage_snapshots ss
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT sector
    FROM breadth.sector_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)
    AND breadth_signal = 'IMPROVING'
) improving_sectors ON ss.sector = improving_sectors.sector
WHERE ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND ss.stage = 'STAGE_2'
AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY ss.relative_strength DESC
LIMIT 20;
